name: gadfly
description: GADFLY: adversarial review stack. Three skills for the three moments work goes wrong: prior-art (scout how the field already solved it, fetched and quoted), critic-gauntlet (parallel multi-model verdict on a proposal, convergence binds), waterfall-lint (sequential receipt-checked scrub of the finished artifact until critics run dry). Gather, Attack, Decide, Fix, Lint, Yield.
